## Company

`res.company`, defined by this module.

Represents a legal entity within the Odoo database. Odoo supports multi-company environments where each company has its own settings, chart of accounts, and business data.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **CFE Paid Monthly** (`rebuild_cfe_monthly_payment`) | boolean |  | Suppress the June CFE advance when the company uses the monthly payment scheme. The annual CFE balance notice remains scheduled. |
| **Cash Projection IS Profile** (`rebuild_corporate_tax_projection_profile`) | selection | yes | Controls the management-only corporate-tax reserve shown on the Accounting Overview. Select the French SME profile when the available evidence supports the reduced rate, then reconfirm turnover, fully paid capital and ownership during each 2065 review. This does not create an accounting entry or a tax declaration. Values: **Standard 25% (Conservative)**, **French SME 15% / 25% (Annual Review)**, **Do Not Estimate**. |
| **Corporate Tax Regime** (`rebuild_corporate_tax_regime`) | selection |  | Values: **Corporate Income Tax (IS)**, **Personal Income Tax (IR)**, **Review Required**. |
| **Automatic Reference Rates** (`rebuild_currency_rate_auto_update`) | boolean |  |  |
| **Automated Coverage From** (`rebuild_currency_rate_coverage_start`) | date |  | First ECB publication date governed by automation. Restored and manual rates before this boundary remain unchanged. |
| **Latest Reference Date** (`rebuild_currency_rate_last_reference_date`) | date |  |  |
| **Last Rate Retrieval** (`rebuild_currency_rate_last_sync_at`) | datetime |  |  |

| **Reference Rate Provider** (`rebuild_currency_rate_provider`) | selection | yes | Values: **European Central Bank**, **Manual Rates**. |
| **Share ECB Rates with Same-Currency Companies** (`rebuild_currency_rate_share_same_base`) | boolean |  | Keep provider-controlled reference rates aligned across allowed companies that use the same base currency. Restored, manual and transaction-specific non-ECB rates remain company-specific and are never overwritten. |

For a French simplified-regime company with a non-calendar financial year, this preserves the statutory 2027 transitional rule instead of switching blindly on 1 January. |
